slides.title: Horizontal vs Vertical Scaling
slides.prompt: What characterizes horizontal scaling in system design?
options: Adding more machine nodes to a pool of resources
Upgrading CPU RAM on a single server instance
Combining all code modules into a single file
slides.correctAnswer: Adding more machine nodes to a pool of resources
